prompt: As of now, which country or countries have won a single medal in the history of the Summer Olympic Games—and it was a gold?
answer:
**None.** As of the end of the Paris 2024 Games—the latest Summer Olympics—no country has won exactly one Summer Olympic medal and had that medal be gold.

Some countries have won **exactly one gold medal**, but they also have other Olympic medals. For example, Suriname, Mozambique, Bermuda, and the United Arab Emirates each have one gold plus at least one silver or bronze.
